A28-3-intro.quote: Appendix A describes the subject matter and duration of the processing

A28-3-a.quote: only on documented instructions from the Controller, including with regard to transfers to a third country

A28-3-a2.quote: If the Processor considers that any instruction of the Controller infringes the GDPR

A28-3-c.quote: technical and organisational measures listed in Appendix B

A28-2.quote: general written authorisation for the sub-processors listed in Appendix C

A28-3-d.quote: engages sub-processors only under the conditions of this Article

A28-4.quote: imposes the same data protection obligations on them by written contract

A28-3-f.quote: assists the Controller in ensuring compliance with Articles 32 to 36 GDPR

A28-3-h.quote: allows for and contributes to audits, including inspections

defects.description: No confidentiality commitment; only staff training is mentioned.
No assistance with data subject requests.
No deletion or return of data at the end of services.
